title: Murder of Narendra Dabholkar
narrative: FIR — Murder of Narendra Dabholkar, Pune, Maharashtra. On 20 August 2013, Narendra Dabholkar, a 67-year-old physician and anti-superstition rationalist who founded the Maharashtra Andhashraddha Nirmoolan Samiti, was shot dead with a pistol by two motorcycle-borne assailants during his morning walk on the Vitthal Ramji Shinde (Omkareshwar) bridge. After a long investigation by the CBI, Sachin Andure and Sharad Kalaskar were identified as the shooters. A special court in Pune convicted and sentenced the two men to life imprisonment on 11 May 2024.
